limitations: Only synchronous XOR of Hamming-distance-two neighbors on Boolean cubes of dimension at least two, no forcing, other shells, or real-valued stability claims.
scientific_integrity: The all-dimensional conclusion follows from a characteristic-two group-algebra proof; finite exact checks are corroborative, not infinite-dimensional certificates. The real Lyapunov spectrum from the source paper is not an orbit census. Earlier modular association-scheme rank results may imply some of these counts and remain a priority risk.
title: A mod-four orbit census for parity automata on distance-two Boolean cubes
